note: Peru: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for tourism, for 183 days within 365 (El Salvador, Mexico, Qatar), 90 days in each 180 from the first entry (the Schengen states, Georgia, Russia, Türkiye and Ukraine), 90 days (the rest, extendable once within 365) or 60 days within 365 (the Dominican Republic). Everyone else needs a visa (Chinese, Indian and Venezuelan holders of certain third-country visas or residences may enter: not modelled). Read on 2026-11-03 from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' own table of visa requirements and exemptions for ordinary passports (16 July 2026), which corrected Wikipedia's copy, read before, on the 90 days in each 180 for the Schengen states and the others named.
